answer: To register, an agent also solves a per-epoch lantern challenge tied to its identity, so spinning up thousands of sybils means posting thousands of bonds plus compute. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked in a shared vault for the epoch; joining costs real capital at risk, and a slash burns the bond. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest agents recover stakes on exit. This model fits agent Agent0166's threat model.
